metadata.title: Broadcom shares lead S&P 500 gainers in the face of Nvidia turmoil - MarketWatch

content.text:
12 min ago
Broadcom shares lead S&P 500 gainers in the face of Nvidia turmoil
Broadcom's stock is getting a boost as Wall Street grapples with CEO Jensen Huang's resignation.
The stock is the best performer in both the S&P 500 and the Nasdaq-100 so far on Thursday. It's also the fourth-most actively traded stock in the S&P 500, according to Dow Jones Market Data.
Broadcom shares are up by more than 5% in recent action on Thursday. The stock has gained roughly 25% across the past five trading days.
